meta.name: pitch-position
meta.description: Produce a complete positioning document using the Dunford framework — competitive alternatives, unique attributes, value, best-fit customer, market category, positioning statement, and tagline. Use when asked to "write our positioning", "define our value prop", "positioning statement", "what market are we in", "how do we position against X", "what's our tagline", or "write our messaging foundation".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用Dunford框架写出你的市场定位、价值主张和标语
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果产品需要清晰的市场定位和竞争策略
copy.tagline_en: Write your positioning, value prop, and tagline using the Dunford framework
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your product needs a clear market position and competitive strategy

howto.what: 当要求写产品定位时，Claude会使用Dunford框架生成包含竞争替代方案、独特属性、价值、最佳客户、市场类别、定位声明和标语的完整定位文档。
howto.when: 当用户提出“写我们的定位”、“定义我们的价值主张”、“定位声明”等涉及产品定位的请求时触发。

say.text: 为我们的新产品写一份定位文档。
say.note: Claude会按框架输出完整文档。

say.text: 定义我们产品的价值主张，针对初创公司客户。
say.note: Claude会生成价值声明和竞争对比。

say.text: 写出针对X竞争对手的定位陈述。
say.note: Claude会分析替代方案并生成差异点。

howto.what_en: When asked to write positioning, Claude generates a complete positioning document using the Dunford framework: competitive alternatives, unique attributes, value, best-fit customer, market category, positioning statement, and tagline.
howto.when_en: Triggers when user requests like 'write our positioning', 'define our value prop', 'positioning statement', or similar positioning-related queries.

say_en.text: Write a positioning document for our new product.
say_en.note: Claude outputs the full framework document.

say_en.text: Define our value proposition for startup customers.
say_en.note: Claude generates value statements and competitive contrast.

say_en.text: Write a positioning statement against competitor X.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes alternatives and derives differentiators.
